They wrote no scientific shard, no mechanism value was persisted or inspected, the remaining tasks and summary were cancelled, and v3 changes only provenance control flow/profile coverage—not any scientific estimator, threshold, or decision gate.
v3_failed_attempt_provenance: The v3 seed-64 evaluator completed and wrote scientific shard SHA-256 921ec1bcb2eab90f775290aa776a47f6f990b8e998ec4fe4b63f32e34e0b5908, but its telemetry gate failed because the wrapper sampled one pre-compute zero and one post-compute/pre-serialization zero. The scientific shard JSON was never deserialized and no mechanism metric or value was inspected; only stdout/stderr, raw GPU telemetry, the metric-free lineage sidecar, telemetry JSON, and the shard hash were inspected. All downstream v3 jobs were cancelled. v4 changes only telemetry handshakes, cadence, provenance, and output paths; scientific computations, estimators, thresholds, and decision gates remain unchanged.
v4_scientific_change_boundary: The evaluator marks one contiguous frozen-v3 scientific-computation block. v4 additions occur only before it (release/start synchronization) and after it (done synchronization, marker provenance, and serialization); no estimator inside the block was edited.
hypothesis: An initial sparse support selects an approximately invariant coordinate subspace of one unchanged global Koopman matrix and its fixed restriction retains long-horizon decoded forecasting.
competing_explanations: support is fate-correlated but not dynamically closed
near-identity dynamics make raw leakage trivially small
arbitrary coordinate subsets of equal cardinality are equally closed
initial projection denoises while repeated restricted dynamics add no value
stable supports exist only after future evolution and cannot route an initial-state forecast

ordinary_forecast_seed_rows.historical_reproduction_kernel: Replay H80, H120, H160, and H200 in the original order with separate rollout_observation_discrete calls, whole [batch times horizon] latent-stack decode, and float32 squared-error reductions exactly matching the frozen original evaluator; assert only the frozen H160/H200 mechanism references.
ordinary_forecast_seed_rows.scientific_kernel_boundary: The historical kernel is provenance-only. Scientific full, mask-once, and repeated-restriction estimates remain jointly evaluated by the unchanged three-mode kernel and may differ at floating-point scale because its decoder batch shape and reduction arithmetic differ.
ordinary_forecast_seed_rows.cross_kernel_discrepancy_policy: Always record absolute and relative differences descriptively; never use them as an adaptive scientific gate.

estimands.row_operator: A = kmat.T because step_latent(z) = F.linear(z, kmat) = z @ kmat.T
estimands.primary_projector: exact score-initial-state mask P0 = diag(abs(E(x0)) > 1e-3), fixed for the full rollout
estimands.secondary_projector: train-fit initial-support family representative assigned from score x0 only, fixed for the full rollout
estimands.estimand_selection: Both exact-mask and family-prototype results are always reported; neither can be selected by outcome.
estimands.full_rollout: z_h = z0 @ A^h; decode every step
estimands.mask_once_rollout: z_0 = z0 * P0, then z_h = z_0 @ A^h with no later projection
estimands.repeated_fixed_restriction: z_0 = z0 * P0; each step z <- (z @ A) * P0
estimands.raw_closure: sqrt(sum ||z_t P0 A (I-P0)||^2 / sum ||z_t P0 A||^2)
estimands.decoded_null_policy: No decoder is applied to coordinate-permuted latents; the coordinate null is raw/operator-only.
estimands.family_derangement: For the two families selected solely by training assignment count, swap their fixed representative masks on exactly those routed score ICs. K and decoder remain fixed; validation routing counts and all forecast outcomes are excluded from selection.
estimands.zero_padded_coordinate_distance_descript: The zero-padded P_f(A-I)P_f distance is reported only as coordinate-chart geometry and is never a decision gate. The joint coordinate null preserves both family cardinalities and pair overlap/Jaccard. No inequivalence under arbitrary latent-coordinate relabeling is claimed.

support.dense_mask: top-k absolute dense coordinates with k equal to paired sparse z0 support cardinality
support.representative_order: descending exact-mask frequency, then packed-mask bytes
support.representative_choice: first mask below Jaccard 0.40 from all earlier representatives
support.cap_behavior: After 256 representatives, unmatched masks remain unknown and are never forced below Jaccard 0.40.

null.reason_no_sign_pairs: The selected sparse arm is ordinary real-valued soft-thresholded conv_lista, not sign-split.

aggregation.absolute_metric_and_null_ratio_median_gu: median across the ten paired model seeds; this descriptive robustness guard has no bootstrap interval
aggregation.paired_ratio_interval: percentile interval of ratio of arithmetic means under paired model-seed resampling
aggregation.paired_ratio_point_estimate: ratio of arithmetic means across paired model seeds, aligned to the paired bootstrap interval
aggregation.projected_vs_dense_full_estimand: 1 - mean_seed(sparse restricted field MSE) / mean_seed(dense full field MSE)
aggregation.projected_vs_dense_full_seed_win: sparse restricted field MSE < paired dense full field MSE
aggregation.signature_ratio_point_estimate: arithmetic mean across qualifying model seeds of observed/null-median signature distance, aligned to its bootstrap interval; median is a separate guard
aggregation.signature_ratio_interval: percentile interval for mean per-seed observed/null-median signature-distance ratios
aggregation.max_t_test: one-sided exact 2^n-sign enumeration of studentized paired null-minus-observed differences; adjusted p is count/2^n with no add-one correction (1024 signs for exact-support n=10)
aggregation.sign_flip_count: 2^n exact signs: 1024 for the n=10 exact-support family and 2^n_eligible for the separately adjusted family-support analysis
aggregation.max_t_multiplicity_policy: Apply the same six-metric one-sided max-T adjustment separately to exact-score-initial supports and to train-fit family supports over their x0-qualified seed set.
aggregation.scope: Uncertainty is over ten model-initialization seeds conditional on one already-opened 256-trajectory score dataset; this is an internally frozen post-hoc mechanism diagnostic, not new-dataset generalization.

family_gates.nontransductive_routing: Every score x0 is independently assigned to the training-only codebook. Score frequencies never remove or change a representative.
family_gates.per_family_qualification: The score-count threshold qualifies uncertainty-bearing per-family/operator estimates only; aggregate routed closure and forecast include every assigned score initial condition.
family_gates.top_two_family_forecast_selection: The two training-codebook representatives with largest training assignment counts, with lower codebook index breaking ties. If either has fewer than 16 routed score x0 states, the seed is ineligible; no score-adaptive substitution is allowed.

closure_specificity_gates.control: paired dense top-k initial mask with cardinality exactly matched trajectory by trajectory

decision_branches.strong_routed_low_leakage_charts_with_di: Exact and train-fit family supports pass the frozen activity and operator low-leakage gates for approximate invariance, correct routing beats a wrong-family swap, sparse projected forecasting beats dense full forecasting, and the fit-frozen pair has distinct low-order orthogonal-basis-invariant dynamical signatures versus the joint-permutation null. This does not establish exact invariance, full operator inequivalence, or universal local laws.
decision_branches.distinct_signatures_without_dense_foreca: Closure, routed-family utility, routing specificity, and low-order signature differentiation pass, but sparse projected forecasting does not beat dense full forecasting; claim chart-specific mechanism evidence only.
decision_branches.distinct_signatures_without_routing_spec: Train-fit family restrictions have distinct low-order dynamical signatures and aggregate closure, but the correct routed chart does not beat an outcome-blind wrong-family swap; do not claim predictive specialization.
decision_branches.multiple_closed_support_charts: Validity, family, closure, and routed-family utility pass but low-order signature differentiation fails; do not claim distinct dynamical signatures or local laws.
decision_branches.state_specific_support_utility: Exact initial-support closure and forecast gates pass but family gates fail; do not claim stable families.
decision_branches.latent_closure_only: Raw closure passes but decoded utility fails; do not claim forecasting-useful support restrictions.
decision_branches.activity_weighted_closure_only: Visited projected states show trajectory-weighted closure, but an absolute operator-level or dense-specificity subspace guard fails; report only activity-weighted closure and never call the coordinate subspaces invariant.
decision_branches.failed: Fixed-support closure fails; make no Allen-Cahn approximate-invariance or low-leakage-chart claim.
decision_branches.invalid: Any provenance, information-firewall, finite-rollout, or roster gate fails.

hardware_profile.telemetry_scope: Synchronized post-warmup synthetic historical-provenance H80/H120/H160/H200 kernels plus unchanged scientific three-mode and closure kernels after both models are resident; excludes import/checkpoint I/O.

scientific_hardware_gates.telemetry_scope: Evaluator-owned GPU-start marker immediately before fail-fast historical replay through evaluator-owned GPU-done marker immediately after the final scientific CUDA synchronization. One-second samples are retained only when both pre-query and post-query checks confirm the done marker is absent; preload, boundary-idle queries, and serialization are excluded.

staged_science_launch.release_rule: Run seed 64 alone, then a CPU validator may reference only lineage, historical-replay validity, information-firewall fields, and GPU telemetry. Release tasks 1--9 only after that validator exits zero.
staged_science_launch.canary_semantic_firewall: The evaluator writes a separate lineage receipt containing no mechanism metric keys. The validator parses only that receipt and telemetry and streams the scientific shard solely for its SHA-256; mechanism metrics are neither deserialized nor used for release.
staged_science_launch.remaining_tasks: Frozen task indices 1--9 with no source, card, threshold, estimator, or gate change after the canary.
staged_science_launch.summary_dependency: Run the frozen reducer only after all remaining tasks succeed.

root_of_trust.source_manifest: Exact-roster SHA-256 manifest of all scientific Python, card, focused test, and SLURM worker/reducer scripts; missing, extra, duplicate, unsafe, or drifted entries fail closed.
root_of_trust.queue_launcher_boundary: The two small top-level queue launchers are intentionally outside the manifest to avoid hash self-reference. They hardcode and verify card+source hashes immediately before sbatch; the post-profile science launcher additionally hardcodes the profile-decision hash.
root_of_trust.worker_boundary: Manifest-pinned workers require the expected hashes from the launcher and independently verify card, exact source roster, profile raw artifacts, telemetry contract, and smallest-passing batch before any outcome computation.
